item.title: JPJ uses high-spec drones to monitor road traffic offences
item.description: MACHANG: The Road Transport Department (JPJ) will use high-specification drones to monitor the travel of road users in Kelantan in conjunction with Ops Aidilfitri this year. JPJ Director-General Datuk Aedy Fadly Ramli said the use of drones was aimed at detecting road users who committed traffic offences, who could then be subject to action through Notice 114 (notice of summons for questioning). item.title: TCL Sparks Inspiration Across Italy with Olympic Winter Games Themed OOH Campaign and Brand Activations
item.description: MILAN, March 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ — TCL, a Worldwide Olympic and Paralympic Partner, has launched a large-scale OOH campaign across Milan to celebrate the Olympic Winter Games Milano Cortina 2026. item.title: Search for MH370 in southern Indian Ocean still no leads

item.title: Magma unit to acquire LUMA Hotel and adjoining buildings in KK for RM60.9 mln
item.description: KUCHING (March 8): Magma Group Bhd’s wholly-owned subsidiary Magma Avenue Sdn Bhd (MASB) is acquiring the LUMA Hotel and four adjoining buildings in Kota Kinabalu for RM60.9 million to expand its hospitality portfolio.
